summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built custom CUDA C++ kernels with memory coalescing and constant memory that cut VGG16 inference latency 35% over naive GPU execution, and optimized a YOLO perception pipeline through TensorRT for a 5.2x speedup (56.7ms to 10.9ms) on NVIDIA Jetson. Background spans parallel computing (CUDA, MPI), real-time embedded systems, and GPU profiling and quantization for edge deployment in PyTorch.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction from camera sensor data.
Combined a custom wavelet denoising bank with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to raise reconstruction quality from PSNR 65 to 86.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into real time HID commands via Python.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript convolution layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory for weights and biases, eliminating per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms versus 73.3ms uncoalesced and 77.5ms CPU TorchScript baseline, a 35% speedup over naive GPU execution with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing on NVIDIA Jetson, a 5.2x speedup from 56.7ms to 10.9ms (17.6 to 92 FPS) versus eager PyTorch.

Built a distributed Jetson and Arduino control pipeline with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping over I2C; resolved 11 integration failures to reach 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 ~0.85) and fine-tuned a lane detection model, integrating both into an adaptive perception, planning, and control stack with lane following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in a multi-agent scenario with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions across multiple laps.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with under 1% accuracy degradation, demonstrating near-lossless compression for edge deployment constraints.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Benchmarked four MPI work distribution strategies rendering 5000x5000 pixel scenes; achieved up to 30x speedup with static strip partitioning across 55 processes.
